title: Prepositions of place & movement
summary: Use place prepositions to describe location and movement prepositions to show direction.

explanation.en: Place prepositions answer where. Movement prepositions show where someone or something moves.
explanation.ru: Предлоги места отвечают на вопрос «где?», а предлоги движения показывают направление.

forms.label: Place
forms.pattern: in · on · at · under · behind · between · opposite · next to

examples.en: The bank is opposite the school.

forms.label: Movement
forms.pattern: to · into · out of · across · along · through

examples.en: The cat is in the box. It jumped into the box.
examples.ru: Кот в коробке. Он прыгнул в коробку.

commonMistakes.note: Use into for movement from outside to inside.
